reason: Refuted AS WRITTEN. The direction is right: realistic geometric post-processing on x138 is <= 0 out of sample, and nothing is possible before R8. But the sentence proposed for LESSONS/IDEAS gets its two headline numbers and one scope claim wrong. Most of the rest is already on record. (1) WRONG BOUND. 'Post-processing on x138 is bounded by the combo oracle (+0.014 joint)' is false. +0.01428 is only the like-for-like GATED round-11 triple. The same measurement gives O_ATT_w +0.02039, a wide joint of +0.03487 (+0.04115 with swaps) and O_EDGEALL +0.06462 (d_adjEdge +0.0586: 1,676 FP edges removed, 1,651 with one end unmatched). The absolute no-new-node ceiling of the bed is +0.1111 (m_joint_oracle.json). The edge-removal family is closed by LB evidence (edge filter +0.016 lab -> 0 / -0.001 LB) and because it needs annotation knowledge, not by a ceiling. (2) MIXED POOLS IN THE AUC CLAIM. '84% of the oracle edits, i.e. AUC ~0.94' pairs the GATED like-for-like oracle with the WIDE-pool threshold. In v_transfer_1 (26 TP / 698 scored negatives, equal-variance binormal model, not measured), +0.012 needs AUC ~0.94 only on the wide pool. On the gated pool the division joint maxes out at +0.0131 and needs AUC ~0.995. The finding's own cited table (m_transfer, AUC 0.95 -> +0.0061 / +0.0092 on the 7/17 pools) sits BELOW the bar, and the v_transfer_1 check puts the 17-pool at ~0.97. (3) 'ONLY DETECTOR/LOCALISATION HAS A CEILING ABOVE THE BAR' contradicts the finding's own learned-attach slot (+0.020 wide) and the edge-removal oracle (+0.065). (4) (b) applies 1/6 to an oracle ('perfect linker < +0.0005 public'); two combo skeptics flagged that as a category error (v_joint_oracle_1 #3, v_transfer_1 #5). The lab numbers alone suffice: no-swap relink +0.00106, dangling-end ceiling +0.0032 (pro-rata, unmeasured; the reachable both-free set is 11 edges, ~+0.0003). (5) EXTERNAL VALIDITY. Everything rests on 2 lab embryos. All 7 gated-attach TPs are in 6bba, and 44b6 has 9 GT divisions. The test is other embryos, so 'rules out' means a lab-bed bound, not a proof. (6) REPEAT. The I-079 geometric form is already closed (IDEAS I-079 Curation 8: '<= 7/62 pass the gates... post-deadline as a learned far-daughter slot'). CONTEXT l.2369-2379 already routes the combo-oracle ceiling to I-079, and I-047 records the mirror/nearest attach refutation. The only genuinely new or corrective item is that the R11-A7 LESSONS line 'linking <= +0.003' should read 'no-swap relink +0.0011 measured; swap share ~+0.006 is a GT identity jump / offset detection, not a linker error'. Feasibility is trivial (text only, no submission, no R1-R10 conflict), but the value is documentation only and the text as proposed would propagate wrong bounds.
